about.heading: 孙琦 Qi Sun
about.subtitle: 类脑计算、智能信号处理与半导体器件智能建模研究者 · 西安电子科技大学人工智能学院
about.bio: 我的研究以类脑计算为核心，关注脉冲神经网络如何在噪声、低功耗和复杂时序约束下稳定工作。雷达信号处理与遥感图像理解是类脑方法的重要应用场景；半导体器件建模则是面向物理系统优化的交叉延展。

sections.title: 研究定位
paragraphs: 我将自己的研究定位在“类脑计算方法 → 智能信号处理应用 → 半导体器件智能建模”的连续谱上。核心问题不是单纯追求模型精度，而是理解模型如何在噪声、稀疏时序、低时延和物理约束下可靠工作。
雷达和遥感在这里更准确地说是类脑计算的应用场景：它们提供复杂信号、真实噪声和低功耗需求，用来检验 SNN 与事件驱动表示的有效性。

sections.title: 学术训练
items: 西安电子科技大学人工智能学院，计算机科学与技术方向；系统接受模式识别、神经网络、深度学习、智能目标识别与 AI 芯片设计训练。
本科阶段为智能科学与技术专业，形成从算法、机器学习到电子电路和器件基础的交叉背景。

sections.title: 方法能力
items: 围绕 SNN 直接训练、替代梯度、时间编码、知识蒸馏和事件驱动计算开展方法设计与实验验证。
面向雷达 PDW 序列和遥感图像，构建类脑信号处理流程，包括分选、去噪、识别、去交织和低时间步推理。
使用 TCAD 数据、物理先验和机器学习模型优化 LDMOS、U-MOSFET 等功率器件结构。

sections.title: 成果谱系
paragraphs: 当前主页收录 {{publication_count}} 篇论文，覆盖 ICML、AAAI、ICASSP、Applied Physics Letters、Electronics、IEEE Signal Processing Letters、Neurocomputing、IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices 与 Micromachines 等会议和期刊。
这些成果分别落在三条主线中：SNN 训练与时间编码机制，类脑模型在雷达、遥感及多模态品质感知中的应用，以及半导体器件建模、结构设计与物理验证。

sections.title: 关键词
paragraphs: Spiking Neural Networks, Neuromorphic Computing, Temporal Encoding, Radar Signal Processing, Remote Sensing SNNs, Signal Deinterleaving, Surrogate Function Optimization, TCAD, LDMOS.

items.title: How can ML support device modeling?

about.bio: My research centers on neuromorphic computing and asks how spiking neural networks can remain stable under noise, low-power constraints, and complex temporal structure. Radar and remote sensing are application settings for neuromorphic signal processing, while semiconductor device modeling is a physically constrained extension of data-driven modeling.

sections.title: Research Identity
paragraphs: I position my work along a continuum: neuromorphic computing methods, signal-processing applications, and intelligent semiconductor device modeling. The central question is not only accuracy, but reliability under noise, sparse temporal representations, low latency, and physical constraints.

Radar and remote sensing are best understood here as application domains of neuromorphic computing: they provide complex signals, real noise, and low-power requirements for evaluating SNNs and event-driven representations.

sections.title: Academic Training
items: School of Artificial Intelligence, Xidian University, with systematic training in pattern recognition, neural networks, deep learning, intelligent target recognition, and AI chip design.
Undergraduate background in intelligent science and technology, connecting algorithms, machine learning, electronic circuits, and device fundamentals.

sections.title: Method Capabilities
items: Method design and experimental validation for SNN direct training, surrogate gradients, temporal encoding, knowledge distillation, and event-driven computing.
Neuromorphic signal-processing pipelines for radar PDW sequences and remote-sensing images, including sorting, denoising, recognition, deinterleaving, and low-step inference.
ML-assisted optimization of LDMOS, U-MOSFET, and related power device structures using TCAD data and physical priors.

sections.title: Publication Footprint
paragraphs: This site currently includes {{publication_count}} papers across ICML, AAAI, ICASSP, Applied Physics Letters, Electronics, IEEE Signal Processing Letters, Neurocomputing, IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices, and Micromachines.

These works map onto three lines: SNN training and temporal encoding, neuromorphic applications in radar, remote sensing and multimodal quality assessment, and semiconductor device modeling, structural design and physical validation.
